name: Tales of the Aes Sidhe I
source:
Tales of the Aes Sidhe I is a first-person visual novel in which we will take control of a young man named Emrys Lefay, who upon turning 18 will discover that he is not a normal human, but the son of a kitsune (a fox spirit from Japanese mythology) and an Aes Sidhe, a term used to refer to a group of humans capable of using magic.

We will have to guide Emrys as he adapts to his new powers and his new life, discovering that the world is much wider and more mysterious than he thought. Everything that humans have dismissed as myths and legends will turn out to be true. Unfortunately, among those myths and legends there are beings and powers with dark intentions that Emrys will have to face in order to protect his loved ones.

We will have to be careful, as the development of the story will depend on our choices throughout the story. Who will we help and who will we ignore? Will we destroy our enemies without mercy or will we pity them? Will we be willing to do anything to save our loved ones, even become a monster?

[From [url=https://tellstory.itch.io/tales-of-the-aes-sidhe-i]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Tales of the Aes Sidhe I》是一部第一人称视觉小说，你将扮演名叫埃姆里斯·勒费的年轻人。年满18岁时，他发现自己并非普通人类，而是一只狐妖——日本神话中的狐狸精——与一名艾斯希族人的后代。在这个世界里，艾斯希指的是一群能够使用魔法的人类。

你需要引导埃姆里斯适应新力量与新生活，并逐渐发现，世界远比他以为的更加广阔、更加神秘。那些被人类视为神话与传说的事物，原来都是真实存在的。然而，其中也潜藏着心怀恶意的存在与力量，为了保护所爱之人，埃姆里斯必须与之对抗。

你必须慎重，因为故事的发展取决于沿途做出的选择。你会帮助谁，又会忽视谁？会毫不留情地消灭敌人，还是心生怜悯？为了拯救所爱之人，你是否愿意不惜一切，哪怕自己也变成怪物？

[摘自[url=https://tellstory.itch.io/tales-of-the-aes-sidhe-i]Itch.io[/url]]
